verdict: OLLIVIER-RICCI CURVATURE = the geometric signature of network structure: on a planted-community graph the edge curvature is BIMODAL -- intra-community edges positively curved (mean 0.12) and inter-community BRIDGES negatively curved (mean -0.21), AUC 1.00 for detecting bridges. RICCI SURGERY (cutting the negative edges) recovers the communities (ARI 1.00) whereas random edge removal of the same count gives ARI 0.00, and an Erdos-Renyi graph has no bimodal gap -- the curvature carries the community signal. Curvature beyond gravity: the cheapest geometric description of a discrete network's structure (curvature-atlas row).
